purpose: Fail-closed determination of whether an active ChatGPT working thread may be declared ready for archive under the StegVerse orchestration model.

archive_term_definition.repository_continuation_state_preserved: Repository handoffs and ledgers preserve enough state for a human or later session to resume work.
archive_term_definition.orchestration_custody_accepted: An active orchestration layer has ingested the thread, emitted a bounded receipt, assigned or scheduled remaining tasks, and accepted continuation responsibility.
archive_term_definition.thread_ready_to_archive: Allowed only when both repository continuation state is preserved and orchestration custody is verified.

prohibited_claims: the prior conversation is not required
required_evidence_before_archive_claim: hash or immutable reference to ingested source
assignment or scheduling receipt for unfinished work
next_machine_actions: preserve this fail-closed archive-custody state in each patent-related mirror handoff
remove or qualify any archive-readiness statement that relies only on repository documentation
when orchestration becomes available, ingest the active thread and emit the required custody evidence
change thread_ready_to_archive only after all required evidence is verified
